lyrics:
[Intro: slow electric guitar lick, organ swell]

[Verse 1: gritty soul baritone, unhurried]
Ten years dry come the fifth of June
Used to chase the bottom of a bottle like the moon
Thought the only warm there was came out of a glass
Then you sat down beside me and you didn't even ask

[Chorus: full band, voice soars, long runs]
Now I'm sweet tea sober
Drunk on nothing but the way you say my name
You're the slow kind of burning
Front porch, sundown, summer rain
I don't miss it, I don't need it, it's over
You got me sweet tea sober

[Verse 2: baritone, organ underneath]
I still know every bar from here to Baton Rouge
I just drive on past 'em now, I got nothing to prove
There's a chip in my pocket and a ring on my hand
One says who I was, one says who I am

[Chorus: full band, voice soars, long runs]
Now I'm sweet tea sober
Drunk on nothing but the way you say my name
You're the slow kind of burning
Front porch, sundown, summer rain
I don't miss it, I don't need it, it's over
You got me sweet tea sober

[Guitar Solo: slow, bluesy, bending notes]

[Bridge: band drops low, voice nearly a whisper]
And on the bad nights, 'cause there's still bad nights
You don't hide the keys
You just leave on the light

[Final Chorus: biggest vocal, held note on the last word]
Now I'm sweet tea sober
Drunk on nothing but the way you say my name
You're the slow kind of burning
Front porch, sundown, summer rain
I don't miss it, I don't need it, it's over
You got me sweet tea sober

[Outro: guitar and organ fade, ice settling in a glass]
